name: Death Cultist

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three attacks, using Dread Scythe or Deathly Ray in any combination.

action.name: Dread Scythe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 16 ({@damage 3d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Spirit Wail {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the cultist. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

fluffEntries: Death Cultist: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 11 para o modo fatal.
